svg.aria-label: Seven phases on one line: validate, design, plan, build, review, launch, retro. Under each, what you approve before the next starts, with an approval mark after each phase. Three notes: design is checked like code by design-check, with no model tokens; build makes the smallest working version first and new ideas wait in later; launch covers positioning, a README people finish and a first-run test. A small script takes the short route: plan, build, review, retro
